applicability_to_unbound: Service case kernel.
recommended_answer: Dissatisfaction-based definition (whether justified or not). Acknowledge within 2 business days; substantive response target 15 business days; outer limit 60 calendar days with a holding response; regulator-originated complaints (state AG/charity regulator, IRS) routed to counsel within 1 business day and answered by the regulator's deadline. Mandatory deadlines in contracts or law override.
remaining_uncertainty: DISP primary text not fetched; state-specific rules unverified.
consequences_if_wrong: Regulator escalation; reputational harm.
conservative_fallback: Shorter targets.
alternative_design: Complaint flagged only when the customer uses the word 'complaint' (cheaper, undercounts).
required_acceptance_criteria: Given a contact flagged dissatisfied and staff-confirmed, then acknowledgement within 2 business days.
Given a regulator-originated complaint, then counsel is assigned within 1 business day.
